scope: Six implementation files, read-only Opus review; not a content quality audit.
resolution: JWT premise rejected: generation-jobs alone uses verify_jwt=false, with explicit admin/custom scheduler authentication. Existing endpoints retain JWT verification.
Accepted: explicit recovery preserves completed steps and known response IDs; ambiguous POST and terminal provider/contract failures cannot be retried automatically.
Internal handler premise rejected: exported handler and import.meta.main guard are already implemented; all three live local replays succeeded.
pg_net installation simplified to CREATE EXTENSION pg_net. Actual migration/cron smoke is required before completion.
Accepted: each cron dispatch advances up to three jobs concurrently under exclusive leases; removed the wall-clock age cutoff that could discard queued work.
Accepted: paid-call cap only applies to a new step; stopped errors have a fallback message.
